properties.description:
`depends_on(from_id, to_id)` draws `Component DEPENDS_ON Component`, joining the nine typed helpers that already fill in endpoint types. It refuses an absent endpoint like every other one, so the convenience does not buy a new way to point a dependency into nothing.

The cross-design version pin that used to hold this name is now served as `external_dependency` (core: `DesignGraph::declare_external_dependency`). The core keeps its verb because it reads as Rust; the served tool drops it because it reads as a noun beside `depends_on`, `allocate` and `satisfies`.

⚠️ A BREAKING CHANGE TO A SERVED SURFACE, taken deliberately rather than deferred: `rule:fix-it-properly-while-it-is-still-cheap`'s second clause makes "it would break consumers" a reason to do it NOW, and the deprecation discipline begins at 1.0.
properties.name: Component coupling is one typed call, and the cross-design pin no longer holds its name
